column3: “The matters and the faithfulness, these” is rendered “these acts of faithfulness.” “Encamped on” is rendered “besieged,” and “said” as “thought.”
“His face was for war” is rendered “he intended to make war.”
“Took counsel” is rendered “decided,” and “stop up the waters” as “cut off the supply of water.”
“The wadi” is rendered “the stream,” and “the middle of the land” as “the region.”
“Strengthened himself” is rendered “took courage.” “Put up on the towers” is rendered “erected towers on it”; the Hebrew is unclear.
“Commanders of wars” is rendered “military officers,” and “spoke to their heart” as “spoke encouragingly to them.”
“With us is one greater than with him” is rendered “the one with us is greater than the one with him.”
NASB adds “only.” “Supported themselves on” is rendered “relied on.”
“He was at Lachish” is rendered “he was besieging Lachish,” and “his imperial might” as “his forces.”
Close to the Hebrew.
NASB supplies “yourselves over.”
“Make smoke” is rendered “burn incense.”
“Really” is rendered “at all.”
“Totally destroyed” is rendered “utterly destroyed.”
“Indeed? for your gods” is rendered “How much less shall your God”; the Hebrew has the plural form.
“Again” is rendered “further.”
“Taunt” is rendered “insult.”
“In Judean” is rendered “in the language of Judah”; NASB supplies “this out.”
“The land” is rendered “the earth,” and “humankind” as “men.”
NASB supplies “to.”
“Annihilated” is rendered “destroyed,” and “with shame of face” as “in shame.” “Some of the offspring of his lower parts” is rendered “some of his own children.”
“Led” is rendered “guided”; NASB supplies “others.”
“Excellent things” is rendered “choice presents,” and “lifted up” as “exalted.”
“Was sick until to die” is rendered “became mortally ill”; NASB supplies “the LORD.”
“Not according to the benefit on him he repaid” is rendered “gave no return for the benefit he received.”
“Humbled himself in the haughtiness of his heart” is rendered “humbled the pride of his heart.”
“Articles of preciousness” is rendered “valuable articles.”
“All livestock and livestock” is rendered “all kinds of cattle,” and “flocks for the stalls” as “sheepfolds for the flocks.”
NASB supplies “acquired.” “Property” is rendered “wealth.”
“Downwards westward” is rendered “to the west side.”
